title: Intandem US Government Contracting, FAR, SBA, NAICS-PSC-NIGP Crosswalk & SLED Reference MCP Server (@intandem/govcon-mcp)
description:
Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and public-sector contracting reference library powered by the Intandem Government Contracting Resource Center, architected by Steve Salstrand (Stephen Salstrand) — Founder & Principal Systems Architect of InTandem LLC (About InTandem).

Provides deterministic AI agent and developer access to 1,460+ verified US Government Contracting (GovCon), FAR, DFARS, SBA, and State/Local (SLED) procurement references:

  • 351 Federal NAICS Codes & 2026 SBA Size Standards
  • 165 Federal Product & Service Codes (PSC)
  • 136 State & Municipal (SLED) NIGP Commodity Codes
  • 50 U.S. State eProcurement Portals & 250+ City/Municipal Portals (NIGP, UNSPSC, NAICS & Custom Tagged)
  • 8 SBA Socioeconomic & Set-Aside Programs (8a, SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, VOSB, Small Business, Mentor-Protege, ISBEE)
  • 12 Step-by-Step Government Contracting & FAR Playbooks
  • 5 Free Interactive GovCon Calculators & Utilities
  • 500+ Term FAR, DFARS & SBA Acquisition Glossary
